audience: Founders and SDRs running outbound from Gmail + LinkedIn + X

bots.why: Owns the outbound queue: research, draft, queue for approval, never sends directly
LinkedIn-flavored drafts: connection notes and follow-ups in the operator's voice
Prospect research: company, role, trigger event, with a cited source per fact
Pre-meeting brief: prospect context, open threads, suggested questions
Revives stalled threads: flags dead deals and drafts the nudge for approval
Weekly pipeline rollup: worked, stalled, next-week queue
Week-1 Bot: diffs installed plugin gitRefs and quotes every move. Installed is not working.

human_steps: Connect Gmail and Calendar via first-party OAuth toggles
Install sheets-mcp for the prospect ledger and docs-mcp for draft storage
Approve the triple-gate policy and the per-day send cap
Review and approve the first 10 outbound drafts before any auto-queue
Connect LinkedIn via approved export/draft flow (no credential sharing)
name: Sales Outbound
policies: SOURCE-GATE: every prospect fact cites its source (profile, filing, post) or it is dropped
EVIDENCE-GATE: every draft links the research row it is grounded in; no invented pain points
ACTION-GATE: every send, connection request, or follow-up needs human approval (draft-only Bots)
SEND-CAP: daily outbound volume cap set by the operator; over-cap queues to next day

routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.prompt_hint: Today's outbound queue: new prospects, due follow-ups, stalled threads; cite ledger rows

routines.name: stale-deal-sweep
routines.prompt_hint: Flag threads idle 7+ days, draft one nudge each for approval

routines.name: friday-close
routines.prompt_hint: Pipeline rollup: sent, replied, booked, stalled; next-week queue

tagline: Prospect, draft, and follow up on Gmail and LinkedIn with a human approving every send
